channel.title: Press Release For Business
channel.description: Company announcements published at permanent addresses with structured data.

item.title: Painter Hotline Announces 25% Off Interior and Exterior Painting Across the Denver Metro Through October 5
item.description: Painter Hotline has announced 25% off interior and exterior painting projects across the Denver metropolitan area, running through October 5, 2026. The discount applies to project labor and does not include the cost of paint.

item.title: Advertising For Contractors Warns Trades Businesses to Prepare Now as Google Folds Local Services Ads Into Google Ads
item.description: Advertising For Contractors is advising trades businesses to prepare for Google's migration of Local Services Ads into Google Ads via pay-per-lead Performance Max campaigns, which began for US advertisers in August 2026 and removes the standalone LSA dashboard and manual cost-per-lead controls.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Publishes a Direct Answer on Medicare and Walk-In Tubs: Original Medicare Does Not Cover Them
item.description: Aging Safely Baths has published guidance stating that Original Medicare does not cover walk-in tubs, which are classified as home modifications rather than durable medical equipment, and outlining the alternative funding routes that may apply.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Highlights Bathroom Accessibility Planning as Households Reconsider Aging-in-Place Renovations
item.description: Aging Safely Baths, a nationwide walk-in tub and barrier-free shower supplier operating since 2012, has published planning guidance for households considering bathroom accessibility renovations ahead of need rather than in response to an injury.

item.title: Elevation Health Pairs Registered-Dietitian Support With Physician-Prescribed GLP-1 Care as Research Highlights an Industry-Wide Support Gap
item.description: Elevation Health structures its telehealth GLP-1 program around registered-dietitian support alongside physician prescribing, in response to published 2026 research identifying high discontinuation rates and limited nutritional oversight across the telehealth weight-management sector.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Expands Generative Engine Optimization Practice as AI Assistants Reshape How Customers Find Local Businesses
item.description: Eye To Ad Media has expanded its generative engine optimization practice, formalizing a service line focused on entity consistency, structured data and machine-readable publishing for businesses that need to appear in AI-generated answers.

item.title: Roof Solutions Urges Metro Atlanta Homeowners to Photograph Roofs Before Storm Season as Georgia Insurance Rules Shift in 2026
item.description: Roof Solutions is advising Metro Atlanta homeowners to establish photographic documentation of roof condition ahead of storm season, citing 2026 changes to Georgia insurance legislation, a City of Atlanta cool roof ordinance and increased carrier scrutiny of roofs over 15 years old.

item.title: World VR Mall Opens Browser-Based Virtual Shopping Concourse With Merchant Storefronts Linking to Live Ecommerce Sites
item.description: World VR Mall has launched a browser-based three-dimensional shopping concourse where visitors walk a central walkway and enter merchant storefronts that link through to those merchants' own ecommerce sites. No headset or download is required.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Launches Rebuilt Website With Faster Load Times and Clearer Accessibility Product Information
item.description: Aging Safely Baths has launched a rebuilt website at agingsafelybaths.com, reorganized around configuration questions households face when planning walk-in tub and barrier-free shower installations.

item.title: A Nu Do Salon Expands Virtual Consultations as Industry Data Shows Roughly Half of Salon Bookings Happen After Hours
item.description: A Nu Do Salon has expanded its virtual consultation service alongside online booking, citing 2026 industry benchmarks placing after-hours booking demand at 46% to 50% of all salon appointments and identifying in-depth consultation as a defining shift in salon service.

item.title: Bighorn Painting Flags Closing Exterior Painting Window as Colorado Overnight Temperatures Approach the Coating Threshold
item.description: Bighorn Painting is advising Front Range homeowners that the Colorado exterior painting season is closing, as most exterior coatings fail to bond below 50°F and overnight lows approach that threshold. The Arvada contractor has outlined what can still be completed and what should wait.

item.title: Showers4Less Outlines Specification Differences Between Barrier-Free Shower Kits as Demand for Accessible Bathing Grows
item.description: Showers4Less has published specification comparison guidance for barrier-free shower kits, covering pan construction, threshold height, wall system compatibility and the subfloor requirements that determine feasibility of a zero-entry installation.

item.title: VR Flying Simulator Launches Browser-Based Procedural Trainer Aimed at Student Pilots Between Lessons
item.description: VR Flying Simulator has launched a browser-based procedural trainer for student pilots covering checklist discipline, instrument scan and navigation tracking. The company states explicitly that it is not an approved training device and logs no hours toward any certificate.

item.title: Bear Creek Auto Glass Advises Drivers That Windshield Replacement Is Not Finished Until Cameras Are Recalibrated
item.description: Bear Creek Auto Glass is advising Colorado drivers that vehicles with windshield-mounted forward-facing cameras require ADAS recalibration after glass replacement, and that miscalibration commonly produces no dashboard warning.

item.title: Rustic Barnwood Furniture Details Custom Commission Process as Reclaimed Material Supply Shapes What Can Be Built
item.description: Rustic Barnwood Furniture has detailed its custom commission process for reclaimed barnwood pieces built in Colorado, explaining how the characteristics of salvaged material determine dimensions, finish and lead time on made-to-order work.

item.title: Search Converts Details Membership Structure for Small Business Growth Program Built Around Strategy Sessions and Community Distribution
item.description: Search Converts has detailed the structure of its business growth accelerator, a membership program combining strategy sessions, campaign testing and distribution through community networks, positioned as an alternative to conventional advertising retainers.

item.title: Advertising For Contractors Releases a Free Chatbot Builder for Trades Websites
item.description: Advertising For Contractors has released a free contractor chatbot generator that produces an installable website assistant, aimed at capturing enquiries that arrive outside business hours.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Publishes Guidance on Grab Bar Reinforcement in Accessible Bathrooms
item.description: Aging Safely Baths has published guidance on wall reinforcement for grab bars, addressing why the anchoring decision has to be made during installation rather than afterward.

item.title: Showers4Less Adds ANZZI Shower Products to Its Accessible Bathing Catalog
item.description: Showers4Less has added ANZZI shower products to its catalog as an authorized dealer, widening the pan, enclosure and fixture options available alongside its existing barrier-free range.

item.title: Roof Solutions Outlines Pre-Winter Roof Checks for Metro Atlanta Homeowners
item.description: Roof Solutions has published pre-winter roof inspection guidance for Metro Atlanta homeowners, covering flashing, gutters, attic ventilation and the small failures that become expensive once winter moisture gets behind them.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Introduces AI Search Visibility Assessments for Small Businesses
item.description: Eye To Ad Media has introduced AI search visibility assessments that test how a business is represented when customers ask AI assistants about its category, and identify which competitors are named instead.

item.title: Elevation Health Publishes a Plain Description of Its Consultation Process
item.description: Elevation Health has published a step-by-step description of its telehealth consultation process, including the assessment stage at which a clinician may determine that an applicant is not a candidate.

item.title: Painting Brighton Shifts to Interior Work as Colorado Exterior Season Closes
item.description: Painting Brighton has shifted its scheduling to interior projects as Front Range overnight temperatures approach the threshold below which exterior coatings will not bond properly.

item.title: A Nu Do Salon Opens Holiday Season Booking and Gift Card Sales
item.description: A Nu Do Salon has opened holiday season booking and gift card sales, advising clients that color work tied to a specific event date should be scheduled with time for a correction appointment if needed.

item.title: DenverSEO.io Publishes Guidance on Local Search for Front Range Businesses
item.description: DenverSEO.io has published local search guidance for Front Range businesses covering service area definition, review velocity and listing consistency.

item.title: Bear Creek Auto Glass Advises Colorado Drivers to Address Windshield Chips Before Freezing Weather
item.description: Bear Creek Auto Glass is advising Colorado drivers to repair windshield chips before freezing weather, as temperature cycling commonly turns repairable chips into cracks requiring full replacement.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Flags Holiday Hours as the Most Common Fourth Quarter Local Search Failure
item.description: Eye To Ad Media has published fourth quarter local search guidance identifying incorrect holiday hours across business listings as the most common and most avoidable failure heading into the holiday season.

item.title: Bighorn Painting Opens Interior Booking for the Winter Season in Jefferson County
item.description: Bighorn Painting has opened winter interior booking across Jefferson County, noting that interior work is unaffected by the temperature constraints closing the Colorado exterior painting season.

item.title: Rustic Barnwood Furniture Publishes Lead Times for Holiday Custom Orders
item.description: Rustic Barnwood Furniture has published lead time guidance for holiday custom orders, noting that reclaimed material availability affects scheduling differently than catalog furniture production.

item.title: Aging Safely Baths Adds ANZZI Walk-In Tubs to Its Accessible Bathing Range
item.description: Aging Safely Baths has added ANZZI walk-in tubs to its accessible bathing range, widening the configurations available to households working within an existing bathroom footprint.
